specs.label: Ports
specs.value: 3 x Thunderbolt 4 (40Gb/s); 3 x USB-C (10Gb/s); 5 x USB-A (10Gb/s); 1 x DisplayPort 1.4; 1 x SD 4.0 (UHS-II); 1 x microSD 4.0 (UHS-II); 1 x 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet; 1 x Front Combo Audio In/Out (3.5mm); 1 x Rear Audio Out (3.5mm); 1 x Rear Audio In (3.5mm); 1 x DC In (19.5V 11.80A)
specs.condition: Host must support required Thunderbolt/USB4/display capabilities; per-port charging ceilings do not imply all combinations or unsupported USB-C modes.

specs.label: Minimum System Requirements
specs.value: macOS 11.4 (Big Sur) or above; Windows 10 (20H2) or above; Thunderbolt 4 Computer; Thunderbolt 3 Computer; USB-C (USB4) Computer; USB-C Computer; Chromebook (Thunderbolt or USB-C); iPad Pro/iPad Air/iPad mini (Thunderbolt or USB-C); Windows Tablet (Thunderbolt or USB-C)
specs.condition: Host must support required Thunderbolt/USB4/display capabilities; per-port charging ceilings do not imply all combinations or unsupported USB-C modes.

specs.label: Audio port arbitration
